name: Washington County, OR
findings: Washington County has 1,830 nonprofit organizations. 843 of them (46%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 686 organizations.
Hobby and sports organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (18% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Washington County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Hobby and sports organizations stand out for volunteering
observations.text: 53 hobby and sports organizations here list volunteering, compared with about 26 in similar places of this size.

confidence.text: Based on 53 organizations here; 42% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What role do hobby and sports organizations play in community life here? Who do they reach, and who might they miss?

observations.title: Few health care organizations list public events
observations.text: 6 health care organizations here list public events. In similar places of this size, about 16 would.

confidence.text: Based on 16 organizations here; 42% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Do people here look for public events through health care groups? Where else does that happen?

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 93 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.

confidence.text: Based on 93 organizations here; 42% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do religious organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?
